subject: MAP & limited-run test kit exchange — timeline and usage constraints
messages:
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@brightcart.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: short MAP + limited-run test kit exchange

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We discussed exchanging a small evaluation bundle (prompt pack + ~500 labelled test cases) so our ML team can validate model behavior on retail checkout flows. High-level asks:

- Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with clear milestones and a 30-day sandbox window
- Limited-use license: no redistribution, no public disclosure, deletion after TTL
- Audit logs and sample usage report at the end of the trial
- Minimal data redaction: PII removed by BrightCart before handoff

Can Redwood take a short MAP and a limited-run testkit under these constraints? If so, can you share a draft and a suggested close timeline? We need to align procurement (cc'ed below) and our security reviewers. I've attached a one-page MAP outline.

Thanks,

Olivia Park
Director, Data & ML
BrightCart
Attachments: BrightCart_MAP_Request_20260614.xlsx

CC: procurement@brightcart.com

From: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@brightcart.com>
Cc: procurement@brightcart.com
Date: 2026-06-14T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short MAP + limited-run test kit exchange

Hi Olivia — great to hear from you and glad the demo was useful. We can definitely do a tightly scoped exchange. Quick proposal based on your bullets: 

1) Scope: prompt pack (read-only), 500 labelled test cases, manifest CSV with labels and redaction notes.
2) Window: 30 calendar days of sandbox access from handoff + 7 days for final reporting (total 37 days).
3) Usage constraints: no redistribution, no public benchmarking, deletion TTL enforced by Redwood.
4) Audit & reporting: we will provide a tokenized usage report and per-route latency/cost summary at the close.
5) Security: BrightCart to provide redaction confirmation; Redwood to enable role-limited access and export restrictions.

I've attached a short MAP draft and a testkit manifest template to accelerate review (attached: Redwood_MAP_Draft_vA.docx, testkit_manifest_v1.csv). Proposed timeline:

- Draft MAP & testkit manifest exchanged by Fri 2026-06-18
- Internal security review / signatures by Tue 2026-06-22
- Handoff and sandbox start Fri 2026-06-25
- Final report and takedown Fri 2026-07-31

If that looks OK I can loop in our legal and solutions engineer for a quick sync. Suggested attendees: Ben Carter (sales), Dev Patel (Solutions Eng), Marissa Cole (Customer Success).

Best,

Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_MAP_Draft_vA.docx; testkit_manifest_v1.csv

From: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
To: ben.carter@redwood.com, dev.patel@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-15T08:37:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: short MAP + limited-run test kit exchange — alignment + pricing ask

Team — forwarding BrightCart's MAP request and my reply. Key points to decide:

- Do we agree to the 30-day sandbox + 7-day reporting window?
- License: limited-run, no-redistribution. Do we need a short addendum or OK with our standard eval T&Cs?
- Pricing/credits: I think a modest credits package (1 GPU-hour pool + streaming tokens allowance) + standard SE support is appropriate; willing to offer a small trial credit to accelerate sign-off.

Dev — can you confirm technical constraints for export restrictions and proof of deletion? We should note whether we will enforce deletion via TTL or run a manual takedown; TTL preferable.

Ben/Marissa — if we push this into a 30-day sandbox it's a classic proof-of-value; happy to propose the credits number but want alignment before I send final MAP.

Thanks —
Lauren

Subject: Re: Request: short MAP + limited-run test kit exchange

Hi Lauren — thanks for the prompt turnaround and clear draft. Procurement and security have reviewed the high level and are comfortable to proceed with the proposed 30+7 cadence, subject to the following exceptions: 

- We need a written assurance of export controls and deletion within 72 hours of window close (Redwood's TTL + manual confirm OK).
- A one-time permitted sample (up to 10 records) may be allowed for debugging if redaction is verified; must be returned/erased after debug window.
- Procurement will require a PO and a DocuSign SOW for the limited-run evaluation.

Please send an updated MAP with the 72-hour deletion confirmation and a suggested credit package. I'll circulate to our security and procurement once received. We can then route the SOW for signature.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this started.

Olivia Park
Director, Data & ML
BrightCart
